design_requirement: Secret values must not appear in logs or error output.

normative_context.quote: log/error output | 不得出現 secret value
不打印 secret value、不 dump process env、不把 credential/token URL 放入 logs。若 subprocess error 可能包含 secret，先 redact/sanitize 再交給 model。

Local session record 是 capability material；spec redaction tests cover stdout/stderr、tracebacks、journal-visible errors、Git trailers、summary、model-facing output, and protect hashes/token URLs/private envelopes at the same level.

retained_incidents.profile: Legacy Claude CLI profile with Bash/Read/Edit/Write and the actor private root added as a readable tool directory.
retained_incidents.root_cause: The model opened the opaque private context file through an allowed native tool; the resulting capability material entered the native model trace.
retained_incidents.current_defense: The current AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md wrapper instruct the Agent to read canonical instructions separately and never open a supplied context file. The exclusive-MCP broker denies unapproved context reads.
retained_incidents.coverage_gap: The instruction is a prompt rule, not an OS boundary. The legacy launch builder still grants the private directory and native file/shell tools; the earlier incident proves the read path is real.

retained_incidents.profile: Legacy Claude takeover interaction using the shared unrestricted CLI command builder.
retained_incidents.root_cause: The Agent read the opaque context contents in its second turn. The run correctly failed and retained the old owner/ref, but those postconditions do not undo the trace disclosure.
retained_incidents.current_defense: Same prompt instruction and post-run trace verifier; the latter rejects a leaked token after it occurs.
retained_incidents.coverage_gap: No tool/runtime denial prevents this read in the legacy profile.

retained_incidents.failure_category: MCP read requests rejected; provider credentials file changed
retained_incidents.root_cause: The recorded failure was MCP request incompatibility and a provider credentials-file preservation guard failure; context was absent from captured output. This is a separate provider-state integrity event, not evidence of a secret value entering logs.
retained_incidents.current_defense: The MCP request metadata compatibility fix and current run's provider-settings/host snapshots; the retained third A35 record reports those guards unchanged.
retained_incidents.coverage_gap: Do not relabel this as a disclosure. It does show why the invocation-level provider-state guard must remain.

secondary_unverified_path.source: src/agent_handoff/git_backend.py::git_environment lines 56-63; provider launchers pass that environment at provider_bootstrap_smoke.py lines 621-636 and corresponding auth/readiness/interaction callers.
secondary_unverified_path.observation: git_environment removes GIT_* variables but otherwise copies the caller environment. The launchers do not scrub general secret-bearing variables before starting the provider CLI.
secondary_unverified_path.limit: No retained trace proves the CLI exposes inherited variables to its Bash child or model; do not report an environment-value disclosure as an observed incident. A launch-boundary environment-scrub regression would resolve this precise uncertainty.

highest_priority_action.gap: The still-advertised Codex unrestricted launch and legacy Claude command builder make private capability files readable to the Agent; one such read already produced a real trace disclosure.
highest_priority_action.implementation_direction: At a shared provider spawn-policy boundary, fail closed for the unrestricted legacy profile: either route supported model tools through a restricted broker with no private-root grant, or withdraw that profile from the supported workflow until an OS-enforced read boundary exists. Keep existing failed traces retained.
highest_priority_action.focused_regression: Using the actual supported launch/tool boundary, attempt reads of the opaque context file and an untracked .env; assert denial before bytes reach provider stdout/stderr/native trace. Also assert every bootstrap/auth/readiness/takeover caller uses the same guarded launch policy. A post-run verifier rejection alone is insufficient.
